rows: Praed demands 8 Guppy because they must exchange numbers with a large billionaire.
Xanz regrettably needs 11 Guppy to play idle games with another gravedigger.
Teodorp wants 16 Bass in order to play idle games with the creepy game developer.
Jetstar wants 8,000 Stonescale Carp to blackmail a shiny DJ.
Xanz requires 11,000 Stonescale Carp to attempt to lick a large dolphin.
Kripplex wishes for 16,000 Sturgem so they can tickle the holy artist.
